name: Sequence Resource Analysis
description: Governed DNA and protein sequence inspection through Proto's typed materialization and validation interfaces.

source.adaptation: Reduced a broad package-oriented bioinformatics skill to Proto's governed, dependency-light sequence contracts.

operations.purpose: Build a bounded DNA parts snapshot from exact eligible resource identifiers.
Search only the selected materialized DNA parts.
Validate selected DNA sequences and constraints.
Build a bounded protein selection from exact eligible resource identifiers.
Validate metadata, sequence digest, alphabet, fractions, and provenance before protein analysis.
